sources.title: Laya AI: Model Selection and API Integration Guide - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Laya AI turns context into bounded decisions: a category, an ordered score, or the probability of a yes/no proposition. The Laya model is useful when your application already knows the possible outcomes and needs help choosing between them. A Laya API makes those decisions available through an HTTP interface, but the model and the service exposing it are separate things.
